rationale: The answer abstains on the central question. It does not state that Reg. 26(2) of the 2026 regulations expressly permits different cut-offs for cash versus in-kind dealing. It also does not state that hedged and unhedged classes may have different cut-offs where currency hedging is at class level. It says it is 'unaware' of Q&A 1030, so it gives no distinction between the express 2026 exceptions and the older reasoned-waiver route. Its claim that cut-offs are 'applied uniformly, not split by cash versus in-kind' contradicts the permitted exception. The material on hedging tolerance (95–105%) is incidental and does not cover the requested cut-off facts. None of the key points are met.
